question: Do the chosen benchmarks' deep-hop splits actually test transfer, or are 3+ hop items systematically composed from relations and entities seen at lower hops (benchmark-construction confound)?
description: MetaQA's higher-hop splits are constructed by composing lower-hop questions, so a model trained on 1-2 hops may already generalize to 3-hop by design; this would make the 'transfer to deeper hops' claim partly an artifact of the benchmark construction. The evaluation must state the hop-depth construction of each split and include a deep-hop set that does not reuse training relations/entities (or a held-out composition split).
rationale: The formalized H2 (low-hop RL transfers to deeper hops) is only meaningful if deeper-hop test items are not trivially reachable from the lower-hop training distribution; the current plan uses MetaQA 2/3-hop plus WebQSP/CWQ without verifying the split construction.
